description: AI-driven security-focused git push with credential detection, file filtering, and deployment metrics tracking. Tests should be run by calling AI and results provided.

branch.description: Target branch for push (optional, uses current branch if not specified)

dryRun.description: Show what would be pushed without actually pushing

forceUnsafe.description: Override security blocks and test failures (DANGEROUS)

message.description: Commit message (optional, commits staged files if provided)

projectPath.description: Path to project directory (defaults to current working directory)

testResults.description: Test results from AI-executed tests (required for proper deployment tracking)

command.description: Test command that was executed by AI

testTypes.description: Results broken down by test type (unit, integration, etc.)

name: smart_git_push
